label: Total Amount of Funds Provided
content: This is the total amount of funds Provider will provide under the FRPA.

label: Total Amount of Funds Disbursed
content: This is the amount Recipient will receive directly after deductions for fees and any third-party payments. See FRPA §1.4 (Itemization of Net Amount Funded) for the breakdown.

label: Total of Payments
content: This is the total dollar amount of payments Provider estimates Recipient will make under the FRPA.

label: Total Dollar Cost of Financing
content: This is the difference between the Total of Payments and the Total Amount of Funds Provided, and it also includes every fee or charge Provider deducts from the Total Amount of Funds Provided — the origination fee and any other amount withheld at funding.

label: Estimated Payments
content: Repayments are not fixed. Each Workday, Recipient's Approved Processor will remit the Specified Percentage of Recipient's gross daily credit and debit card receipts to Provider until the Total of Payments is collected. Actual payments will vary with Recipient's daily revenue.

label: Estimated Average Monthly Income (assumption used)
content: This is the assumed average monthly income through your Approved Processor's card settlement used to derive the estimated periodic payment and term above. If actual income differs, both will adjust.

label: Prepayment
content: If Recipient pays the Total of Payments faster than estimated, Recipient will not be charged any additional fees. There is no prepayment penalty. See FRPA §8.3 (Voluntary Prepayment). Buyer does not offer a prepayment discount; the full unpaid Purchased Amount is delivered (FRPA §8.3).
